title: Marguerite and the Wolf
author: Mara Zhou
blurb: Wren Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
